set.body: From the cold review of 97161f239. Result[A] = Either[String, A] is stringly and run exposes it publicly (rule 12). Refusal text mixes ReferentError.toString with .message, and one test pins the toString form. InputSchema, GraphSchema, Usage, InputRoles and main lack why-Scaladoc. p.hint.get is safe but fragile. publish uses a plain Files.move after a check; use an atomic move where the filesystem allows.
set.title: S3c-1 follow-up F5: typed errors, Scaladoc and atomic publish in sourceIdentity
